subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language. 'LDWR' is coded as 'NGUQ' and 'BFKZ' is coded as 'DIIY'. What is the code for 'YTGX' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First and second letters → (2) and (3) are added to the position value respectively.

Third and fourth letters → (2) and (1) are added to the position value respectively.

​​So,

'LDWR' is coded as 'NGUQ'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c32e429119556253e4349f61af4e727defe797e8b1ae5180dc0e250f4bfcbb9.png] 

​And,

'BFKZ' is coded as 'DIIY'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67320051c3aff778ef948086314cae8401de9b37e05e2b3895ee12db52a94bf2.png] 

​Similarly,

'YTGX' is coded as

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3155e5dec5dd3eac88dd2a8f6975084a19f5f9798d7081abb8eaaf78e3729a06.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
